yt_description:
Still managing your dealer network on spreadsheets? Missed targets. Stock blind spots. Endless follow-ups.

Stackby turns your spreadsheets into a real Dealer Portal: onboarding, orders, stock, targets and claims — one portal for every dealer. Import your sheet, every row becomes a record, and your portal is live in minutes. Or just describe what you need and Stackby AI builds it.

👉 Build your dealer portal, free to start: https://stackby.com/signup

What's inside
• Dealer Directory
• Dealer Orders
• Stock & Inventory
• Targets & Incentives
• Warranty Claims

Why teams switch
✅ One portal, every dealer: orders, stock, price lists and claims self-serve.
✅ Live network view: sales vs. target by region, in real time.
✅ Dealer-only access: each dealer sees only their own data.
✅ Faster onboarding: KYC to first order in days, not weeks.
